results.content: It catalyzed a revolution both in software (directly contributing to the rapid rise of OSS communities like Linux) and hardware (enabling innovation in instruction set architectures and new business models) by freeing the former from fragmented C/C++ implementations, and the latter from having to chase rapidly evolving C/C++ language standards. In a 2011 retrospective, modularity was cited as enabling the LLVM community to scale, leading to new developer tooling like clang-format, and unlocking innovative programming languages (Rust, Julia, Swift and more). results.content: Betty B Liu, Selin Jessa, Samuel H Kim, Yan Ting Ng, Soon Il Higashino, Georgi K Marinov, Derek C Chen, Benjamin E Parks, Li Li, Tri C Nguyen, Austin T Wang, Sean K Wang, Meng How Tan, Serena Y Tan, Michael Kosicki, Len A Pennacchio, Eyal Ben-David, Anca M Pasca, Anshul Kundaje, Kyle KH Farh, William J Greenleaf (2026) *Nature*. Transcription factors establish cell identity during development by binding regulatory DNA in a sequence-specific manner, often promoting local chromatin accessibility and regulating gene expression1."). Mapping accessible chromatin offers critical insights into transcriptional control, but available datasets for human development are restricted to bulk tissue, single organs or single modalities2."). Here we present the Human Development Multiomic Atlas, a single-cell atlas of chromatin accessibility and gene expression from 817,740 fetal cells across 12 organs, spanning 203 cell types and more than 1 million candidate *cis*-regulatory elements, many of which exhibit organ-specific in vivo enhancer activity.

results.title: Research on Functional Modularity and Health Monitoring Design of Home Fitness Equipment
results.content: Intelligent fitness systems with wireless sensors and optical measurement technology can monitor heart rate, breathing rate, and exercise intensity in real time for more accurate health feedback [[5](https://www.mdpi.com/2673-4117/6/6/115#B5-eng-06-00115),[6](https://www.mdpi.com/2673-4117/6/6/115#B6-eng-06-00115)]. In [Figure 2](https://www.mdpi.com/2673-4117/6/6/115#fig_body_display_eng-06-00115-f002), a smart device holder is provided at the handrail, which is convenient for users to place a tablet computer or mobile phone; meanwhile, the monitoring devices on both sides of the handrail are able to monitor data such as heart rate and energy consumption in real time, and the exercise bike module mainly provides aerobic exercise. In order to better guide different groups to adapt their health conditions to exercise, we use fitness equipment with monitoring functions, as shown in [Table 10](https://www.mdpi.com/2673-4117/6/6/115#table_body_display_eng-06-00115-t010), to guide people of different age groups to choose the appropriate exercise methods, and at the same time, provide feedback on the physical health status of different people. [](mailto:?&subject=From%20MDPI%3A%20%22Research%20on%20Functional%20Modularity%20and%20Health%20Monitoring%20Design%20of%20Home%20Fitness%20Equipment%22&body=https://www.mdpi.com/3333240%3A%0A%0AResearch%20on%20Functional%20Modularity%20and%20Health%20Monitoring%20Design%20of%20Home%20Fitness%20Equipment%0A%0AAbstract%3A%20Under%20the%20%26ldquo%3BHealthy%20China%26rdquo%3B%20strategy%2C%20the%20demand%20for%20home%20fitness%20equipment%20is%20increasing%2C%20but%20existing%20solutions%20face%20challenges%20such%20as%20large%20size%2C%20limited%20functionality%2C%20and%20lack%20of%20personalization.%20This%20study%20proposes%20an%20innovative%20integrated%20design%20framework%20for%20multifunctional%20home%20fitness%20equipment%2C%20combining%20modular%20design%2C%20space%20optimization%2C%20and%20intelligent%20health%20monitoring.%20The%20design%20integrates%20an%20exercise%20bike%2C%20rowing%20machine%2C%20and%20spring%20tensioner%20into%20a%20single%20unit%2C%20reducing%20equipment%20footprint%20by%2030%25%20while%20enabling%20seamless%20transitions%20between%20exercise%20modes.%20Multimodal%20sensors%20collect%20real-time%20physiological%20data%2C%20processed%20via%20Kalman%20filtering%20and%20adaptive%20algorithms%20to%20generate%20personalized%20fitness%20recommendations.%20The%20system%20achieves%2095%25%20monitoring%20accuracy%20for%20key%20metrics%20%28heart%20rate%3A%2097%26ndash%3B147%20bpm%2C%20energy%20consumption%3A%20216%26ndash%3B550%20kcal%29%20and%20improves%20user%20satisfaction%20by%2040%25%20compared%20to%20conventional%20equipment.%20This%20research%20demonstrates%20a%20scalable%20and%20intelligent%20solution%20that%20bridges%20the%20gap%20between%20multifunctional%20integration%20and%20user-centric%20health%20management%2C%20offering%20significant%20advancements%20over%20previous%20designs.
